partners.mechanism_chain: FANCG (HGNC:3122) —DISRUPTS→ Fanconi anemia pathway (GO:0000709); ATR (HGNC:701) —DISRUPTS→ DNA damage checkpoint regulation (GO:0000077); Fanconi anemia pathway (GO:0000709) —BINDS→ DNA damage checkpoint regulation (GO:0000077); DNA damage checkpoint regulation (GO:0000077) —LEADS_TO→ Increased predisposition to oropharyngeal cancer (HP:0030060); DNA damage checkpoint regulation (GO:0000077) —LEADS_TO→ Familial cutaneous telangiectasia (HP:0001066). Loss-of-function mutations in FANCG impair the Fanconi anemia pathway, while mutations in ATR disrupt DNA damage checkpoint regulation.
